strategies.name: session_bias_opening_range_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Determine directional bias from the 7:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. one-hour candles using an engulfing pattern before the New York session: bullish engulfing for longs, bearish engulfing for shorts. Then on the 5-minute chart mark the 9:30-9:45 opening range, wait for price to break and close in the bias方向
strategies.exit_summary: Enter on the retracement into the chosen point of interest after the breakout, with the stop beyond the structure/zone used for entry (e.g. below demand or below the range for longs, above recent wick/supply for shorts). Take profit at a left-side supply/resistance level for longs or support/demand/
